notes: True homograph of the existing H6693 (צוק¹, "constrain; oppress"), both spelled צוק -- added as צוק² per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H6693 is retroactively renamed צוק¹ in this same batch.

Gloss kept as the requested compound: Job.28.2 ("brass is molten out of the stone") shows the metallurgical "melt/smelt" sense, while Isa.26.16 ("they poured out a prayer") and Job.29.6 ("the rock poured me out rivers of oil") show the general "pour out" sense -- genuinely distinct, each independently cited. Job.28.2 and Job.29.6 compete for the same yiqtol/3ms slot (Job.28.2 wins the usual tie-break), but "pour out" stays fully supported regardless via Isa.26.16's own separate slot (perfect/3cp).
